_comment: Models used in the paper. 'revision' pins the Hugging Face commit (resolved 2026-10-26); provenance also records the revision actually loaded. 'thinking' marks reasoning models (E5). Backends: hf (HuggingFaceVLM), vllm (VLLMBackend), openai (OpenAIVLM).

qwen3-vl-4b.note: bfloat16 fails S3E 0.5.0's pad-invariance check for batched HF queries (max P difference 0.185 on 2026-10-26), so HF runs use float32; vLLM does not pad. vLLM uses top-20 logprobs: full-vocabulary logprobs ran at ~5 queries/s vs ~210 (L40S), and top-20 matched HF float32 (mean |dP| 0.010, 98.9% same decisions, 1,048 atoms)

qwen3-vl-8b.note: bfloat16 fails S3E 0.5.0's pad-invariance check for batched HF queries (max P difference 0.185 on 2026-10-26), so HF runs use float32; vLLM does not pad. vLLM uses top-20 logprobs: full-vocabulary logprobs ran at ~5 queries/s vs ~210 (L40S), and top-20 matched HF float32 (mean |dP| 0.010, 98.9% same decisions, 1,048 atoms)
qwen3-vl-8b.role: mid-size open VLM; HF-vs-vLLM scaling model

gemma-4-e4b.role: mid-size open VLM; thinking off by default

qwen3.5-0.8b.role: reasoning model (template thinking off by default)

qwen3.5-4b.role: reasoning model (template thinking on by default)

vev-4b.role: open vision decision model (Qwen3.5-4B + Vev adapter); CC BY-NC 4.0, weights not redistributed

ministral-3-3b-reasoning.role: reasoning model ([THINK] blocks; HF backend only)

llava-ov-72b.role: the 2025 workshop paper's model family (E7); multi-GPU
